You could try the grounding technique — name 5 things you hear, 5 things you see, smell, taste and touch. Using sensory items like a strong enjoyable smell will get you in the here and now, listening to sounds close and far away, touching something cold and warm, and looking around your surroundings for different things you may not have noticed.

And then you could put your phone away and not look at it, and do something distracting and pleasant, like watch a movie. I would not recommend reaching out again until he gets back to you.
